name: Collections
description: Pages of products gathered by conditions — the catalogue's own filter, saved: categories with their subcategories, characteristic values (the brand among them), the filter's yes/no boxes (in stock, on sale…), a price range — plus products picked by hand and products left out. Each collection has its address, cover, text and dates; the page is the catalogue's listing with its filters and sorts. A list of all collections, a block of collection tiles, and "products of a collection" in any product block.
